facts.q: Is the person wearing a device on their legs, with braces or cuffs on the thighs and shins?
Are there thin dark poles reaching from under the hips or thighs down to the ground?
facts.when: the person is sitting with thighs roughly horizontal

must_not: a pole or leg in front of the knee or shin
a person with more than two legs
fidelity_clause: Reproduce this exact Sitka exoskeleton from the reference: braces on the thighs and shins worn on the person's own legs, one thin carbon pole under each hip that reaches the ground only when seated, a carbon leaf spring at each knee, the back panel and belt. Do not add, remove or move any part. Photoreal.
